NodesRef SelectorQuery.select(string selector)

Select the first node that matches the selector on the current page. A NodesRef object instance is returned, which can be used to obtain node information.

Parameter

string selector

Selector

Return Value

NodesRef

selector syntax

A selector, for example, a CSS selector, supports only the following syntax:

  • IDselector:#the-id
  • Class selector (selects multiple consecutive classes):.a-class.another-class
  • Sub-element selector: .the-parent > .the-child
  • Descendant selector:.the-ancestor .the-descendant
  • Union of multiple selectors: #a-node, .some-other-nodes

Sample Code

Page({
  onCreateSelectorQuery() {
    ma.createSelectorQuery()
      .select('test1').boundingClientRect()
      .select('test2').boundingClientRect()
      .selectAll('.all').boundingClientRect();
  }
});
